proposition.claim: The paper defines \(G=\widetilde R+v^*_{t+1}(b+\widetilde R)\) and \(\nu=\mathbb E[G\mid S]\), with \(S\) eventual survival. Theorem 2’s proof uses \[q=-b\Pr(S^c)+\mathbb E[G\mathbf1_S].\]

repair.content: The supplied replacement uses realized total clipped return \(H\), which telescopes to \(-b\) on ruin. Writing \(S_a\) for survival probability and \(M_a=\mathbb E[H\mathbf1_{S_a}]\), the exact identity is \(q_a=-b(1-S_a)+M_a\). Hence \[b(S_{\hat a}-S_a)\geq M_a-M_{\hat a}\ \Longrightarrow\ q_{\hat a}\geq q_a.\] This proves a comparison with a different return-gap definition, rather than the original theorem unchanged.
